groups.rationale: Verification reference records two recorder-host harness fixes from run c5b80845: the TCG translation cache cap that keeps the recorder VM inside its container memory limit, and the published-archive settle wait for one-new-batch checks; harness-only, no product behavior change.

Reviewed the final analysis-only Earmark PLT entry and public parser capture against the existing recursive Markdown validator. Parsed foreign data still requires complete node validation; accepted documentation structure, language negotiation and user behavior are unchanged. The already-updated lifecycle, security and scenario chapters retain exact browser/admission evidence and the current MFA timeouts without claiming a passing normal gate.

Reviewed lifecycle, security and shared coverage chapter changes against unchanged protocol sources. The Git identity admission gate and bounded BEAM/browser evidence do not change manifest schemas, wire identities, capability policy or native transport authority; historical firmware launch scope remains separate.

Reviewed corrected Marshall admission documentation and shared scenario evidence against unchanged Lilly sources. Retained agentless executions and historical Lilly-only firmware launch keep their existing trust, readiness, storage and recovery boundaries; current browser and admission fixtures establish no new host or guest acceptance.

Reviewed shared lifecycle, security and scenario chapter changes against unchanged service sources and the separately recorded Porsche gates. Marshall browser metadata and test fixture custody do not change Porsche wire fields, human-output catalogs, terminal bytes or any service transport and native execution boundary.

Reviewed shared coverage and security updates against unchanged fleet and Nix deployment sources. Current synthetic browser and database-backed admission results do not change placement, image identity, native machine behavior, storage ownership or physical isolation; the historical Lilly firmware receipt retains its original scope.

Reviewed ADR-0170 admission evidence, ADR-0201 partial implementation links, ADR-0191 fixture review and the safe browser receipt. Chapter 19 distinguishes the 28-locale, 112-combination settings result, current firmware unit pass and MFA timeouts from historical native and twenty-history passes. Reviews record fresh 36-of-36 Covenant evidence and nine remaining incoming Android Dialyzer findings; no full-suite or native acceptance is claimed.
